content:
Miles: Thanks for joining the live Q&A. A few people asked for concrete rollout windows for API changes, Console features, and Optimize. I'm summarizing what leadership committed to and tagging owners.

Leah: API runtime (gen2): internal canary next Tue, partner canary 3w later, GA targeted ~6 weeks after partner canary. We'll surface a clear opt-in flag `api_version=gen2`. No auto-migration for pinned models.

Rosa: For teams using webhooks and streaming today, will behavior change or just performance tweaks?

Leah: Minor framing changes for streaming (better partial payloads). Behavior kept backwards-compatible for 90 days post-GA. We'll publish code samples for webhook consumers.

Ken: Dedicated clusters: do we need scheduled maintenance windows to apply runtime updates? Customers ask about downtime.

Leah: Dedicated: planned control-plane rollout, then rolling node updates with live migration where possible. We'll surface maintenance windows; default is non-disruptive but we'll give exact windows per customer.

Sam: Console timeline? Folks want per-route cost breakdown and rollout UI.

Rosa: Console beta (internal + pilot partners) starts April 20. Public opt-in beta mid-May. GA end of Q2. Beta includes per-route token breakdown, model-level latency charts, and a simple canary control (start/stop/rollback).

Ken: Will Console show Optimize suggestions?

Leah: Yes 97 Console will show Optimize's batching and quantization suggestions as one-click experiments during public alpha. Integration planned for late-May.

Miles: Optimize specifics: batching advisor vs quantization recommender dates?

Leah: Batching/caching advisor: internal alpha in 2 sprints, public alpha by month-end. Quantization recommender (with model-specific quality estimates) is a broader feature targeted for Q3. We'll publish an RFC + sample eval sets before public launches.

Sam: Any changes to SDKs? Breaking API surface?

Rosa: Small SDK changes: `client.stream()` emits a new `partial_function_args` event. We'll open Python/JS PRs right after internal canary. Deprecation of old stream frames 90 days after GA; opt-in extended support available for customers needing more time.

EngOps Bot: deploy-bot: "canary-start: api/gen2-runtime -> alpha-cluster at 1976543225"

Miles: Actionables: 1) @Leah publish timeline + migration checklist by EOD tomorrow. 2) @Rosa open SDK PRs and doc the deprecation schedule. 3) @Ken coordinate Dedicated maintenance notice templates and share with CS. 4) Product to draft public beta invite process.

Leah: I'll post the timeline doc to #eng and update the public roadmap entry.

Rosa: I'll queue SDK PRs and add sample code for webhook consumers.

Ken: I'll work with CS to finalize maintenance language and share with Sales.

Miles: If we missed any raised panel questions, paste them here and we'll route to owners. Thanks everyone :rocket:
